article.story: No. 5 Ohio State (3-1) at No. 14 Iowa (4-0), Oct. 3 at 3:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Ohio State by 14.5. Against the spread: Ohio State 3-1, Iowa 3-1. How to watch: CBS Key stats Ohio State Offense Overall: 522 yards per game (8th in FBS) Passing: 365.3 yards per game (2nd) Rushing: 156.8 yards per game (76th) Scoring: 45 points per game (6th) Ohio State Defense Overall: 274.3 yards per game (27th in FBS) Passing: 160.3 yards per game (17th) Rushing: 114 yards per game (45th) Scoring: 12.3 points per game (11th) Iowa Offense Overall: 429 yards per game (48th in FBS) Passing: 213.5 yards per game (86th) Rushing: 215.5 yards per game (27th) Scoring: 32.8 points per game (58th) Iowa Defense Overall: 239.8 yards per game (10th in FBS) Passing: 152 yards per game (12th) Rushing: 87.8 yards per game (19th) Scoring: 8 points per game (1st) Iowa ranks 13th in FBS in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 26.8% of third downs. Iowa is 21st in the FBS with a +4 turnover margin. Iowa is 19th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 71.4% of trips. Team leaders Ohio State Passing: Julian Sayin, 1,206 yards, 10 TDs, 1 INT, 72.2 completion percentage Rushing: Bo Jackson, 283 yards on 50 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Jeremiah Smith, 617 yards on 33 catches, 7 TDs Iowa Passing: Hank Brown, 700 yards, 5 TDs, 0 INTs, 68.0 completion percentage Rushing: Kamari Moulton, 284 yards on 39 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Tony Diaz, 247 yards on 20 catches, 1 TD Last game Ohio State beat Illinois 42-19 on Sept. 26. Sayin passed for 367 yards on 27-of-36 attempts (75.0%) with four touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball seven times for 29 yards and one rushing touchdown. Ja'Kobi Jackson had 56 rushing yards on 10 carries and one touchdown. Smith recorded 217 yards on 12 catches with four touchdowns. Iowa beat Michigan 20-19 on Sept. 26. Brown threw for 227 yards on 21-of-35 attempts (60.0%) with two touchdowns and no interceptions. Moulton had 44 rushing yards on 13 carries, adding two receptions for two yards. Reece Vander Zee put up 66 yards on five catches with two touchdowns. Next game Ohio State hosts Maryland on Oct. 10. Iowa plays at Washington on Oct. 9.
